mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce equity discount rates and boost market sentiment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals overheating, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL indicate a monetary tightening cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1% monthly) signals recessionary risks, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST) below 950 units indicate weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 950.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 900 units signal a weakening housing market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as immediate monetary easing boosts short-term market sentiment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.
